Manifest.Name: 可能是按键统一优化 / Probably Unified Hotkeys
Manifest.Author: 太湖白1231
Manifest.Description:
将《深空当铺》原版与工坊模组的快捷键、常规设置合并至官方 ESC「选项」页。
【操作说明】 • 按 ESC 打开「选项」；点击按键录入，按 Esc 设为「无」，左/右键取消。 • 修改后点击底部「应用」保存；支持 3 套本地预设与剪贴板导入导出。
【主要功能】 • 统一视图：按分区折叠卡片，支持原版样式与一键「恢复默认」。 • 按键增强：支持 Shift / Ctrl / Alt 组合键、鼠标侧键（Mouse3~6）与空键解绑。 • 快速检索：支持简繁中英与拼音搜索，自带 [!] 冲突集中筛选。 • 方案快照：提供 3 套本地预设槽位与剪贴板 JSON 秒级备份恢复。 • 智能整理：模组标题中文化显示，支持疑难配置项排查。 • 流畅响应：选项开窗、改造件列表与退出游戏防卡顿优化。
---
Merges vanilla and workshop mod hotkeys and settings into the official ESC "Options" menu.
[Usage] • Press ESC to open "Options"; click any key to rebind, press Esc to clear ("None"), left/right click to cancel. • Click "Apply" at the bottom to save; supports 3 local preset slots and clipboard import/export.
[Features] • Unified View: Collapsible cards matching native style with per-section "Reset to Default". • Enhanced Keybinds: Supports Shift / Ctrl / Alt combos, mouse side buttons (Mouse3~6), and unbinding to "None". • Fast Search: Search via Chinese (Simp/Trad), Pinyin, or English with [!] conflict filter. • Profile Snapshots: 3 local preset slots and 1-click clipboard JSON backup/restore. • Smart Organizing: Localized mod section titles and unresolved keybind diagnostics. • Smooth Performance: Anti-stutter optimizations across Options menu, Mods list, and quitting.
